'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 99 [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[State of Israel|Israeli]] airstrikes on [[Gaza City]] and the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-07-15/ty-article-live/idf-says-two-rockets-most-likely-intercepted-after-sirens-sound-near-gaza-border/00000198-0bf5-dd18-a7dd-0bff2f090000 (Hazzretz)]
*[[Syrian civil war#Fall of the Assad regime, transitional government (2024–present)|Aftermath<!--per the sources in the articles--> of the Syrian civil war]]
**[[Southern Syria clashes (July 2025-present)|Southern Syria clashes]], [[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
***[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli warplanes]] carry out strikes targeting [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian government forces]] as they attempt to enter the [[Druze in Syria|Druze]]-majority city of [[Suwayda]] in southern [[Syria]]. [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] claims he ordered the strikes for the protection of the Druze from forces aligned with the [[Syrian transitional government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-druze-leader-urges-local-fighters-confront-incoming-government-troops-2025-07-15/ (Reuters)]  [https://www.thetimes.com/world/middle-east/article/syria-druze-sweida-city-rgt326mvj (''The Times'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
***The [[Puntland]] [[Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Democratization|interior ministry]] reports at least five militant casualties in [[Dhahar]], [[Haylan region]], following a coordinated campaign as Puntland's [[Puntland Dervish Force|defence forces]] repels an assault backed by the [[Somali federal government]]. [https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-forces-repel-eastern-sool-terrorists-backed-by-villa-somalia-in-dhahar-mogadishus-proxy-war-exposed/ (Idil News)] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/puntland-accuses-somali-federal-government-of-destabilizing-peaceful-regions (Garowe Online)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**At least 12 people are killed in Israeli air strikes in Lebanon's eastern [[Bekaa Valley]]. The missiles struck a number of military compounds belonging to the armed group [[Hezbollah]], including training camps affiliated to its elite [[Radwan Force]]. These were the deadliest strikes since a ceasefire ended a year of fighting between [[Israel]] and [[Hezbollah]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gdvngp0eeo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A pick-up truck veers off a road in [[Pithoragarh]], [[India]], and plunges into a 300-meter gorge, killing eight people and injuring five others. [https://www.msn.com/en-in/news/India/8-killed-5-injured-as-vehicle-plunges-into-300-meter-gorge-in-pithoragarh-cm-dhami-orders-urgent-rescue-operations/ar-AA1IEzyh?ocid=BingNewsVerp (MSN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Indonesia–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a new [[Trade agreement|trade deal]] with [[Indonesia]], where Indonesia will purchase $15 billion in energy and $4.5 billion in agricultural products, along with 50 [[Boeing]] jets. Indonesia will also allow importation of U.S. products without tariffs, while the U.S. will maintain a [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration|19% tariff]] on all goods coming from Indonesia. [https://www.ft.com/content/bd753b35-816e-42be-9697-9f6f230fdd32 (''Financial Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[US airstrikes on Yemen]]
** The [[Federal Constitutional Court]] of Germany dismisses a case brought about by Yemeni plaintiffs accusing the German government of failing to prevent deaths from US drone strikes on Yemen coordinated from [[Ramstein Air Base]], citing the lack of a "sufficient connection" to the German state’s authority and "a serious danger of systematic violation" of international law. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-yemen-us-drones-ramstein-court-95a7138b7b0686135c08daaf78a9e52d (AP News)]
*[[Protests against Donald Trump]]
**[[Protests against the second presidency of Donald Trump]], [[June 2025 Los Angeles protests]]
***The [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] announces that it has ordered 2,000 troops from the [[National Guard (United States)|National Guard]] to leave [[Los Angeles]] after being sent to deal with [[June 2025 Los Angeles protests|the protests]] against the [[United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement|ICE]] raids. [https://apnews.com/article/immigration-raids-los-angeles-national-guard-4424658cc059df31317a83cb53c2b59e (AP)]
